title: networking-fun lab manifest
description: Schema for .platform/manifest.yaml. Validates the lab/scenario/ttl/notes declared by a PR. Slice 8 expands the scenario enum with three fault scenarios for layered-reachability; slice 11 adds the three-tier-segmentation lab.

lab.description: Lab to provision. v1: layered-reachability only.

scenario.description: Fault scenario for the chosen lab. happy-path is the baseline; the three fault scenarios each break one layer (NACL, endpoint, DNS) and the probe matrix flags expected-vs-actual.

ttl.description: Time-to-live duration (e.g. 30m, 2h). Capped at 4h by the validator; default 4h.

notes.description: Free-text note rendered in the PR comment.
